long_biography.plain_text:
Marican began with Mario Canciello's agricultural and property activities in Campania. His sons later took responsibility for the enterprise. Michele became the least publicly visible of the three brothers: a decisive participant in important choices rather than its principal public spokesman. The succession preserved a family platform while broadening its ambitions.

The brothers formed the modern group in 2005 and developed industrial sites serving national and international tenants across the Naples-Caserta corridor. Michele also acted as an administrator of Marican Building, connecting group strategy with construction delivery. The portfolio subsequently widened into clean energy, food, hotels and services, but tailored industrial property and integrated logistics remained its organising core.
